A '''BoSS Documentation Datapad''' was a secure [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] issued by the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] to record a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] official information. The datapad's information could only be changed by attaching it to a customized format input plug available only at BoSS and [[Imperial Space Ministry/Legends|Imperial Space Ministry]] offices. This was the only way that new information or permits could be downloaded to the pads. A separate port allowed data to be downloaded from a ship's [[Computer/Legends|computer]]; the data could not be edited and was presentable only in read only format.<ref name="PSG" />

While seemingly secure, BoSS Documentation Datapads could be circumvented. Some [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forgers]] could turn the read only port to a write only one, although at risk of frying the internal electronics of the datapad. Other forgers managed to get their hands on a BoSS input plug or manufactured their own. Low price forgers would crack the casing of the datapad to change the information inside. Canny [[Customs official/Legends|customs officials]] would check for damage to the datapad during inspections.<ref name="PSG" />
